ms.text:
MP1 react metal(s) with hydrochloric acid in a suitable container (beaker / flask / test-tube)
fair test – max 3
MP2 same / specified / stated / known volume of acid
MP3 some / known / stated concentration of acid
MP4 same / known / stated / measured (start) temperature of acid
MP5 same / stated / specified mass or moles of metal
measurement
MP6 time until all solid gone
OR
MP6 time until set volume of gas collected
OR
MP6 measure volume of gas after a set time
OR
MP6 measure temperature after reaction over / after a fixed time / highest temperature
conclusion
MP7 shortest time is most reactive
OR
MP7 largest volume of gas in set time is most reactive
OR
MP7 largest temperature / highest temperature change is most reactive
If more than one method given, marks are awarded for the highest scoring method
max 6
